review_scope: All available branch tips fetched at audit time; pinned inference paths reviewed separately. Branch tips are not each separately evaluated.

Light-WAM/main.finding: Only available branch. Original episode loop used unchanged; Long-only baseline.

LoopWAM_NT/LoopWAM_NT.finding: Original aligned loop implementation. Selected aligned cache-mapping and prefill functions have equivalent ASTs to pinned KV code; no blanket numerical cross-branch equivalence claim.

LoopWAM_NT/KV_concat.finding: Adds KV mix/concat modes and associated contracts; preserves existing asymmetric-depth support. Latest tip versus executed revision has no src/experiments changes; later commits concern training continuation, retained epochs, runners, documentation and timing logs.

Fast-WAM/main.finding: Current main action scheduler train/infer shift defaults are 1.0; executed snapshot and explicit queued config use 5.0. Source defaults do not establish released checkpoint historical training shift. Base FastWAM/MoT/action DiT/video DiT/VAE/runtime unchanged; native observation/action conversion and episode loop ASTs unchanged. Evaluation orchestration, dataset v3 support and separate IDM/joint model code changed. Do not describe this run as latest-main default evaluation.
Fast-WAM/main.evidence: git diff 8afd20f fastwam-audit/main -- configs/model/fastwam.yaml; main config lines 53-55; commit 0050a44

Fast-WAM/dev/fix_gpu_oom.finding: Ancestor of executed snapshot, not a newer fix. CPU checkpoint-loading fix is incorporated. Older dictionary-cache APIs lack the tensor-cache/compile interfaces required by current graph wrapper; not a drop-in alternate branch. Cross-branch numerical parity not tested.
Fast-WAM/dev/fix_gpu_oom.evidence: git merge-base 8afd20f fastwam-audit/dev/fix_gpu_oom returns this tip

Fast-WAM/web_pages.finding: Website-only branch: README.md, index.html, assets, static and .gitignore. No executable policy/evaluation implementation.

review_verdict: No demonstrated new defect invalidating SR in reviewed paths. Comparison matches simulator protocol while retaining native model semantics. Timing boundaries, preprocessing, training scope and selected Fast-WAM historical scheduler configuration must remain explicit. Queued GPU gates and final grid verification are still required.
